title: Nightly test job fragment
description: Written by validate_notebooks.py (--dashboard_dir) in every nightly test job and rewritten after each notebook, so interrupted jobs still report partial results. Internal contract between test jobs and build_report.py; not consumed by the dashboard directly.

job_id.description: GitHub job id (job.check_run_id); used to link the fragment to the job.

python_full_version.description: Full version of the interpreter running the validation script.

openvino_base_version.description: OpenVINO version in the validation environment before tests start; null when missing.

complete.description: True once all planned notebooks were processed.

planned.description: Notebooks (paths relative to the notebooks directory, posix separators) in scope of this job, including skipped ones, in execution order.

results.description: Processed notebooks. Planned notebooks missing here were not processed (job interrupted).

notebook.description: Path relative to the notebooks directory, e.g. 'async-api/async-api.ipynb'.

return_code.description: treon exit code; -42 means killed by timeout.

peak_rss_bytes.description: Peak resident memory of the treon process tree (sampled).

openvino_before.description: OpenVINO version in the notebook venv before execution; null when missing.

openvino_after.description: OpenVINO version in the notebook venv after execution; null when missing.

packages.description: Versions of KEY_PACKAGES installed after execution (only packages that are present).

env_id.description: Hash of the pip freeze after execution; file envs/<env_id>.txt in the fragment artifact.

log_file.description: Relative path of the captured notebook output inside the fragment artifact; kept only for non-passed notebooks.
